body.name: Exact fan-in-one algorithm
body.construction: \(\mathsf A_1\) builds the normalization in \(\mathrm{def:mobius\mbox{-}sat\mbox{-}handle}\), solves \(\Psi\), tests extendibility of every admissible value in the queried component, and reconstructs full coefficient matrices or a nonconstant interval-parametrized curve using \(\mathsf{Cert}\).
